law_name: Law on Comprehensive Protection of Personal Data (Law No. 172-13)
jurisdiction: Courts (habeas data); Superintendency of Banks for credit data
applies_to: Public & private entities holding personal data files
key_requirements: Lawful & fair processing, consent, data security, habeas data rights (update, rectify, delete)
data_categories: Personal data; sensitive data; credit data
penalties_range: Up to 100x national minimum wage fine; prison 6 months-2 years
exemptions: Art. 3 excludes: files kept by individuals for exclusively personal/domestic activities; intelligence and investigation agency files; data of deceased persons
deceased_data: Not covered: files of deceased persons excluded from the law's scope (art. 3)
notes: Judicial habeas data enforcement; amendment bill (post TC/0484/16) not confirmed enacted
